title: Sieved Mirror Kernels, Gonek-Hughes-Keating versus Entire Exponential Prime Factors, Prime-Power Purity on (X, X^2], and Functional-Equation Obstructions
description: Paper VI of the series on the Transverse Wronskian of Riemann's Xi-Function. Establishes strip-holomorphic sieved mirror kernels Phi_X(u) under canonical Wronskian normalization, compares Gonek-Hughes-Keating's truncated Euler product P_X(s)^{-1} against the entire zero-free exponential factor E_X(s) on sigma > 1 (proving exact annihilation on [2, X], prime-power purity b_N^E(X) = Lambda(N)/ln N on (floor(X), (floor(X)+1)^2), and universal [0,1] contractivity), and proves three critical-strip obstructions in 0 < sigma <= 1: lack of a functional equation leaving the reflected Riemann-Siegel branch unsieved, tautology of truncated theta < 1/2 and O(1) stall at d ~ 1/ln t, and single-line weight divergence w_n*(d_0) -> -infty alongside Selberg's explicit-formula zero sum.
